stories.title: Edit one draft reliably
stories.text: I can type, select, complete, recall, paste and undo Unicode in the actual session without losing a draft.

stories.title: Choose the send key
stories.text: I can choose and remember Enter or Alt-Enter while seeing the active policy and save outcome.

stories.title: Keep the working environment
stories.text: My original prompt/dividers/full-width input and fast startup stay intact while a turn runs.
